Compare CI lengths and discoveries across selectors and inference methods

ciratio.Rd

A research helper: fits the full model, stepwise AIC and BIC, lasso and MCP (each with lambda = "best" and "compact"), runs UPSI, the bootstrap and (where supported) selective inference on each, and tabulates the mean and median CI length and the number of significant terms. Internal; call it as selectInferToolkit:::ciratio().

Usage

ciratio(
  formula,
  data,
  family = c("gaussian", "binomial", "poisson"),
  nonselection = c("ignored", "confident_nulls", "uncertain_nulls"),
  conf.level = 0.95,
  B = 250,
  direction = "forward",
  select_factors_together = F,
  pad = c("zero_side", "none", "all"),
  inference_target = "selections",
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

a formula

data

a data frame

family

outcome distributional family

nonselection

how UPSI and selective inference handle non-selected variables; see infer_upsi()

conf.level

.95 by default

B

number of bootstrap resamples

direction

stepwise search direction: "forward" (default), "backward" or "both"

select_factors_together

should categorical variables be jointly selected (stepwise)?

pad

how bootstrap intervals are padded; see infer_boot()

inference_target

bootstrap inference target; see infer_boot()

...

passed to the full-model and MCP selectors

Value

a list of three matrices, each with one row per selector and columns UPSI, Bootstrap and Selective Inference (NA where a method doesn't apply). All exclude the intercept.

avg_ci_ln

mean CI length

med_ci_ln

median CI length

no_sign_disc

number of terms with p < 0.05 (bootstrap: CI excluding 0)
